C1107.title: South Korean High School Student Arrested for Creating and Selling Deepfake Pornography
C1107.summary: In September 2024, a high school student in North Gyeongsang Province, South Korea, was arrested for using deepfake technology to generate pornographic content and selling it via Telegram. The suspect allegedly offered custom videos featuring the buyer's family members, acquaintances, or celebrities, highlighting the trend of juvenile involvement in deepfake sex crimes in South Korea.

references.title: Selling 'deepfake' pornographic content, a South Korean high school student arrested
